newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Micro to cut 200 jobs, take charge.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Micro to cut 200 jobs, take charge.

text.p: Advanced Micro Devices Inc Thursday said it will cut up to 200 jobs and take a $6 million charge in the current quarter.

"In light of weak demand, the company has carefully reviewed operations in order to achieve and maintain appropriate staffing levels," Advanced Micro said in a statement. "Issues that were identified as a result of those reviews included overlapping or redundant activities and skill sets that do not match current or future requirements. These concerns are being addressed by the workforce reduction."

Advanced Micro, which manufacturers semiconductors, reported a $35 million loss in the second quarter ended in June versus a profit of $80.7 million in the year-ago quarter, reflecting a significant decline in revenues from its once-lucrative flash memory chips.
